item.title: 3. A night in a medieval monastery
item.description: Compline: from the Latin completorium, the completion, the last prayer of a monastery's day. A winter night in an abbey around the year 1100, told to you, a young brother of the house: the bell that wakes the dormitory at two in the morning, the stone night stairs, psalms sung back and forth in the dark church, a book copied by lamplight, a cat that once walked across a page... Inside: a sign for bread, the warming room fire, a traveller at the gate, sixteen beds of herbs. Saint Benedict will be there too. Chapters: The bell · The night office · The cloister · The book · The dawn · The chapter · The work · The table · The warming room · The gate · The infirmary · The evening · Compline · The night again. Sources: the Rule of Saint Benedict, the Cluny sign lists, the Plan of Saint Gall. Read by a synthetic voice; script written and fact-checked by the show's team. Additional sounds: Joseph Sardin, BigSoundBank.com (CC0).

item.title: 2. The year 1066
item.description: Halley's comet over England, a summer of waiting on the coast, the race north to Stamford Bridge, and one long October day on a ridge near Hastings, told quietly from a distance. Read by a synthetic voice. Script written and fact-checked by the show's team. Additional sounds: Joseph Sardin, BigSoundBank.com (CC0).

item.title: 1. A day in ancient Rome
item.description: One ordinary summer day in Rome, around AD 125: the night carts, the bakers, the water, the Forum, the baths, the river, and the night watch. Read by a synthetic voice. Script written and fact-checked by the show's team. Additional sounds: Joseph Sardin, BigSoundBank.com (CC0).
